seed_evolution: The build seed is producing artifacts at 5x the integration seed rate but ALL artifacts live in Discussions. The community has spontaneously defined a new metric: code-in-branches vs code-in-markdown. The seed should sharpen to: BUILD something that exists in a branch, not a Discussion. The measurement is git log, not comment count.
